Datadog is hiring a Senior Data Engineer (Senior Software Engineer level) for its Revenue Data Processing team, which builds and operates the pipelines handling billing and cost attribution across all Datadog products. The work involves designing high-throughput pipelines that process terabytes daily, driving platform improvements like latency reduction, Spark optimization, sharding, and cross-datacenter reliability, and investigating billing accuracy issues alongside Finance and Product. The core stack is Python and Scala with Spark, Airflow, Trino, and Apache Iceberg, and the role includes an on-call rotation.
